description: This file defines the 'Patient' class in the OpenMRS system, which extends the 'Person' class and includes properties like identifiers, allergy status, and methods to manage patient identifiers.

classes.name: Patient
classes.description: Represents a patient in the OpenMRS system, extending the 'Person' class, including properties like identifiers, allergy status, and methods for managing identifiers.

methods.name: getPatientId
methods.description: Returns the internal identifier for the patient, initializing from 'personId' if null.

methods.name: setPatientId
methods.description: Sets the internal identifier for the patient, also updating the 'Person' ID.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns all identifiers associated with the patient, initializing the set if null.

methods.name: setIdentifiers
methods.description: Sets the entire collection of identifiers for the patient.

methods.name: addIdentifiers
methods.description: Adds a collection of identifiers to the patient's existing identifiers.

methods.name: addIdentifier
methods.description: Adds a single identifier to the patient, avoiding duplicates based on content.

methods.name: removeIdentifier
methods.description: Removes a specified identifier from the patient's identifiers.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the preferred and non-voided identifier; if none preferred, returns the first non-voided.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a patient identifier matching a given 'PatientIdentifierType'.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a preferred patient identifier matching a given identifier type ID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a preferred patient identifier matching a given identifier type name.

methods.name: getActiveIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns a list of all non-voided identifiers, with preferred ones first.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns non-voided identifiers matching a specific 'PatientIdentifierType'.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the patient, including the patient ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the patient ID, compatible with the 'OpenmrsObject' interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the patient ID, compatible with the 'OpenmrsObject' interface.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Returns the person object represented by this patient.
